tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The lead bidder should have minimum 02 years experience of smart parking operation and maintenance at a government organization only.b.The lead bidder must be a service provider having experience in the operation and maintenance of the multi level parking facility by installing smart parking solution consisting of both parking management system and parking guidance system with an aggregate capacity of at least 550 four wheeler and 150 two wheeler in an any government organization. Relevant work orders issued by the competent authority of the government shall be submitted
The Bidder's average turnover in any three years of last five (5)financial years is 160Lakhs
